svg.title: T11 Trials motorcycle, left side elevation
svg.desc: Observed-trials motorcycle: very high wide handlebar, minimal seat pad, fuel tank under the seat unit, aluminium twin-beam frame, small two-stroke single with bash plate, radiator and fan, footpegs placed for standing, long-travel fork, linkage monoshock, 21 in front and 18 in rear spoked wheels with soft tubeless trials tyres.
